text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that focuses on harmonizing land-use CO₂ flux estimates between global bookkeeping models and national greenhouse gas inventories. It does not involve land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or future scenario modeling. Instead, it analyzes historical emissions/removals from 2000–2020 and addresses conceptual differences in defining anthropogenic fluxes, particularly in managed forests. The study uses existing LULC data as input but does not predict or simulate future LULC changes. It lacks all core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction: no future scenarios, no LULC prediction objective, no mapped LULC projections, and no spatial modeling of land cover change. While it includes national-level disaggregation, its primary focus is carbon accounting reconciliation, not LULC dynamics. Thus, it meets the exclusion criterion “No LULC prediction component.”)
